newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian state notes issue reaches 6.93 bln Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian state notes issue reaches 6.93 bln Bfr.

text.p: The Belgian Finance Ministry said in a statement on Tuesday that an issue of two state notes reached 6.93 billion francs at the end of Monday, the sixth day of subscriptions. Subscriptions run until Tuesday, June 3.
The ministry sold 1.496 billion francs of its revisable coupon 3/5/7-year notes and 5.434 billion of its five-year fixed coupon note, extendable to seven years.
Belgium hopes to raise 54 billion francs from four note issues planned for 1997/1998. Last year it raised 53 billion francs when it had targeted 80 billion.
The state notes are aimed at retail investors in direct competition to commercial banks' savings, or "cash", bonds, traditionally Belgium's most popular investment vehicle.
The popularity of cash bonds has waned, however, against the background of falling European interest rates.
